verdict.rationale: Replit's docs describe generating full apps (frontend UI plus backend logic, database, auth, hosting) from a natural-language prompt via Agent, matching the prompt-to-app story closely (replit-docs-2, replit-docs-24, replit-docs-10, replit-docs-28, replit-docs-32). Community comment corroborates its 'vibe coding' capability as strong, though other community reports raise reliability/bug concerns rather than disputing the core frontend+backend generation ability. Missing for 10: independent technical benchmarks or detailed hands-on walkthroughs specifically verifying simultaneous frontend+backend generation quality, and no vendor documentation isolating this exact combined capability distinct from general 'build an app' framing.
